# Line Art

Line art: turn a photo from your MegaScenes library or a description into clean black outlines with no shading, for illustrations, tattoo stencils, embroidery, laser cutting and prints.

## What it does
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library or describe the subject, and choose the style. Claude tells you the price and draws it as clean outlines.

**How the files are made:** each line drawing is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Black outlines on a white background, with no shading or color.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install line-art@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Line Art talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/line-art/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each line drawing uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The line drawings show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_line_art_models` | Models for line drawings with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_line_art_cost` | Exact price of one line drawing before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_line_art` | Starts one line drawing in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_line_art` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Turn my latest MegaScenes photo into clean line art"
- "Draw a minimal line art rose with leaves"
- "Make continuous line art of a cat sitting"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the line drawing (the subject and style you describe and the photo you pick from your library, if any) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
